primary_meaning: The four cardinal directions (north, south, east, west), representing the whole earth, all nations, or universal scope

alternatives.meaning: Destructive or chaotic forces of divine judgment acting upon the earth
Heavenly spirits or angels dispatched from God's presence
The life-giving breath or Spirit of God coming from every direction

notes: Across standard Christian biblical interpretation and commentaries the directional/universal sense is the most consistently recognized primary symbolism, with contextual overlays (judgment, gathering, or life) treated as secondary applications rather than competing core meanings.
